given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner is logged in and viewing their dashboard
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine identifies a delivery task within their defined service area
given_when_then.then: The system displays the delivery slot details including route, estimated arrival time, and item list for the partner to accept or reject

given_when_then.given: The Delivery Partner is within their defined service area
given_when_then.when: The system loads the list of available delivery slots
given_when_then.then: Only delivery slots within the Delivery Partner's defined service area are displayed to the partner

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has reached their maximum workload capacity
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign a new delivery task to that partner
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the assignment and does not display the slot as available to the partner

given_when_then.given: A delivery slot has been assigned to a Delivery Partner
given_when_then.when: The system validates the assignment against current workload rules
given_when_then.then: The slot is marked as active only after the agent explicitly accepts the assignment

success_criteria: The system filters and displays only delivery slots located within the Delivery Partner's defined service zone.
Delivery slots exceeding the maximum capacity defined for the partner's service zone are excluded from the view.
A delivery slot is not marked as active or confirmed until the agent explicitly accepts the assignment.
The system displays the estimated arrival time based on the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot.
